lines.text: David defeated the Philistines and took Gath, and he defeated the Moabites, who brought him tribute.
David defeated King Hadadezer of Zobah and captured a thousand chariots, but he hamstrung all the horses except a hundred.
David struck down twenty-two thousand Arameans of Damascus and placed a king in Damascus, so the LORD made David victorious.

wrong_details.true: placed garrisons in Aram of Damascus

lines.text: David brought Hadadezer's gold shields to Jerusalem, and Absalom later made the bronze Sea from the bronze of Tibhath and Cun.

wrong_details.wrong: Absalom later made the bronze Sea

lines.text: Abishai struck down eighteen thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt, and David reigned over all Israel with Joab over the army.
